text:
sophia: Quick note — proposing we lift the runtime compatibility hold for runtime v2.16 tomorrow during the 09:00-11:00 PT change window. Main constraint: SDK v1.8 needs a tiny patch. Can we coordinate canary + docs update? @alex @dinesh

alex: what exactly failed in the SDK tests?

sophia: SDK unit tests: tokenization edge-case + streaming API header. Failing test count small, reproduced locally. Patch ready in branch `sdk/1.8/compat-fix`.

dinesh: ops+infra have capacity in that window. prefer a gradual canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on error-rate > 1.5% for 10m.

maria: will update release notes and the changelog snippet. also need to add an eval in the perf-runbook for long-seq throughput — last canary showed a 3% latency bump on txl=8.

sophia: good call. plan: 1) merge sdk fix 2) build runtime image with KV-cache hotfix flag 3) deploy canary to us-west-2 5% 09:10, monitor 30m -> escalate.

release-bot: deploy queued: runtime:v2.16-rc3 + sdk:v1.8.1-rc1 -> canary us-west-2 (5%). change-window=09:00-11:00 PT. run_id=deploy-2085554321-rc3

alex: can we add a preflight smoke that exercises streaming + tokenization? I can add a lightweight harness.

dinesh: yes add `smoke/stream-token` step. If smoke fails we'll abort and mark hold. ops-bot will post rollback cmd.

sophia: included in playbook. docs snippet to add to release notes: "Lifted temporary runtime hold after SDK compatibility patch; canary deployed with streaming/tokenization smoke checks."

maria: I'll attach the changelog excerpt and a one-line customer-facing blurb: "Improved streaming header handling for better turn-taking fidelity."

release-bot: canary started: deploy-2085554321-rc3 -> 5% at 09:10:22 PT

ops-bot: smoke/stream-token step passed on canary nodes (3/3). latency delta within expected bounds. monitoring channel #infra-observability notified.

alex: cool — running expanded tests now (integration + long-seq perf). will report back in ~20m.

sophia: if integration + perf look good we promote to 25% at 09:45 then 100% at 10:30. keep rollback threshold strict.

dinesh: noted. tagging this thread for postmortem notes if anything odd: `#runtime-compat-lift-2085554321`

maria: uploaded release note draft to drive: https://redwood/doc/release-notes/2085554321-draft.md — please review.

alex: expanded tests green. long-seq perf diff now within 1%. recommend proceed.

sophia: proceeding to 25% now.

release-bot: promotion: deploy-2085554321-rc3 -> 25% at 09:47:10 PT

ops-bot: monitoring OK. no error spikes.

sophia: will push final release note and close the hold after 100% promotion. thanks all. :tada:

release-bot: promotion: deploy-2085554321-rc3 -> 100% at 10:31:05 PT. hold cleared.
